## 2D TILE MAP PAINTER — COMPLETE CAPABILITY MAP

### 1. DATA MODEL: Storage & Persistence

**Core Data Structures (typed arrays for O(1) mutations):**

| Layer | File | Structure | Storage | Persistence Key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiles (ground) | tileData.ts:19-48 | TileMap { cols, rows, idx: Int16Array } | Per-cell kind index (-1 empty) | tileLegend[] names |
| Height field | heightData.ts:31-42 | HeightField { cols, rows, tilesX, tilesY, z: Float32Array } | Float32 sample grid (2 samples/tile + 1) | Quantized int16 × HEIGHT_Q (0.01m steps) |
| Water depth | chunks.ts:36-40 | HeightField (same shape as height) | Float32 depth grid (parallel to height) | Quantized int16, stored only when wet |
| Flora (plants) | floraData.ts:89-106 | FloraMap { cols, rows, layers: { grass, tree, bush } } | Per-layer Int16Array (3 layers, each -1 to flora kind index) | Separate flora grid + floraLegend[] names |
| Zones (areas) | zoneData.ts:20-34 | ZoneMap { cols, rows, idx: Int16Array } + ZoneDef[] global | Per-cell zone index + named defs (id, name, color, flags) | zones[] array in snapshot |
| Roads (strokes) | roadData.ts:55-63 | RoadStroke { id, name?, points: RoadPoint[], profile: RoadProfile } | Centerline polyline + cross-section profile | roads[] in snapshot; planRoads() re-derives tile stamps |

**Chunk Grid (sparse 120×120-tile chunks):**
- Seed: chunk (0,0) at address 'a0'
- Grow: into any in-bounds, unoccupied neighbor (152 cols max, 8 rows max)
- ChunkKey = "cx,cz"; cell address = "gx,gz" (global cells = cx·CHUNK_TILES + lx)
- Files: chunks.ts:29-82, mapStore.ts:1-26

**Persistence (mapStore.ts):**
- Format: MapSnapshot v4 (v1→v4 migration supported)
- Tile grid: RLE-encoded, indexed by tileLegend names (remap on load)
- Height: RLE-encoded quantized int16 (round(z × 100))
- Flora: RLE-encoded, 3 separate layers per cell
- Water: RLE-encoded quantized int16 (absent = dry)
- Roads: recipe stored (recipe + stroke profile + name), NOT the derived tile raster
- Road undercoat: cellKey → prior tile index, so editing/deleting restores paint beneath
- Files: mapStore.ts:183-418 (serializeMap/deserializeMap), editorWorld.ts (GameState integration)

---

### 2. PAINT INTERACTION LOOP

**Pointer Event → Brush Application → Mutation → Sync (PaintCanvas.tsx 2217 lines):**

```
down-event (line ~1500+)
  → claimWasd (focus)
  → tool dispatch (pointer/brush/eraser)
  → onBrushDown(screenX, screenY)
    → screenToGraph(__canvas_screen_to_graph, Zig coordinate mapping)
    → resolveCell (chunk + local cell)
    → BEGIN stroke: heightStamped = new Set() (per-stroke dedup)
    → notifyEditBegin() (snapshot for undo)
    
move-event (~100/s input rate)
  → onBrush(screenX, screenY) [interpolated segment from last point]
    → for each sub-sample (high-res stroke):
      → target dispatch (paint/height/zone/flora/place/road)
        → stamp* at graph position
          → mutate chunk buffers IN-PLACE (chunk.tiles.idx / .height.z / .flora.layers / .zones.idx)
          ��� touched.add(chunkKey)
          → mark dirty: tileDirty/heightDirty/waterDirty/zonesDirty/floras
      → touchChunk(k): call usePaintedField.touch() for each dirty chunk
        → schedules ONE flush per frame (coalesced)
    → emit edit note (coalesced to once per move-event)
    → scheduleRegionSync (320ms throttle)
    
up-event
  → endStroke()
    → syncRegionsNow() NOW (do not throttle)
      → buildFloors() [re-encode dirty chunks only]
        → tileCache.set(k, encodeTileMap) [if dirty]
        → heightCache.set(k, downsampleChunkFloorHeights) [if dirty]
        → waterCache [if dirty]
        → onFloors(ChunkFloor[]) → 3D preview update
    → log stroke stats (samples, stamps, unique cells, coalesced syncs)
```

**Key Perf Features:**
- **Decouple input rate (100/s) from upload rate (once/frame max):** usePaintedField.ts:28-54
  - Input calls touch() → set dirty flag only
  - Frame scheduler batches → ONE re-encode + ONE GPU upload
  - At a 120×120 chunk: ~14,400 cells, uploading every 16ms would choke; coalescing makes a fast stroke upload once
  
- **Per-chunk dirty tracking:** Only re-encode/cache chunks actually painted
  
- **Region sync throttle (320ms):** Rebuilding 3D preview mesh is expensive; 3 syncs/sec is imperceptible
  
- **Height dedup per stroke:** heightStamped Set tracks global sample cells; stationary brush stamps once, drag still stacks across cells

**Coordinates:**
- Screen space (sx, sy) → Graph space (gx, gy) via Zig host __canvas_screen_to_graph
- Graph → Chunk (cx, cz) + local cell (lx, lz) via resolveCell
- Sample/height grid: global cell frame (chunk-agnostic), shared between all chunks that border that edge

---

### 3. BRUSH SYSTEM

**Brush Types & Modes (brush.ts 28 lines, heightData.ts 62-112, BrushRail.tsx):**

| Parameter | Type | Range | File | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shape | 'circle' \| 'square' \| 'diamond' | — | brush.ts:1, BrushRail.tsx:32-35 | Footprint outline (Euclidean/Chebyshev/Manhattan distance) |
| Size (radius) | 0–40 tiles | — | PaintCanvas.tsx:122, BrushRail.tsx:33 | Brush reach (1 tile = 1m = TILE_UNITS px at canvas scale) |
| Mode | 'paint' \| 'erase' | — | brush.ts:2, painterBehavior.ts:15 | Paint/erase toggle |
| Profile (height) | 'cone' \| 'flat' \| 'dome' | — | heightData.ts:61, BrushRail.tsx:45-49 | Cross-section: linear / plateau / hemisphere |

**Per-Target Brush Applications:**

| Layer | Mode | Behavior | Code Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tiles (paint)** | paint | paintTile(m, cellX, cellZ, kindIndex) → m.idx[cellZ·cols+cellX] = index | tileData.ts:35-39, PaintCanvas.tsx:~1100 |
| | erase | paintTile(..., -1) | PaintCanvas.tsx |
| **Height** | brush | stampBrush(heightField, ...) → weighted max per cell in profile | heightData.ts:89-112, PaintCanvas.tsx:~866 |
| | ramp | stampRamp(heightField, ...) → lerped plane (min→max along angle) | heightData.ts:131-157 |
| | slope | stampSlopeBrush(...) → profile height driven by cumulative stroke distance | heightData.ts:196-204 |
| | smooth | stampSmoothBrush(...) → fit plane to local footprint, lerp toward it | heightData.ts:268-299 |
| | erase | stamp with erase=true → set cells to 0 | heightData.ts:103, 242 |
| **Water** | paint | stampBrush(waterField, ...) where depth = -bed (fills negatives to 0) | PaintCanvas.tsx:~900 |
| | erase | paintWater(..., -1) | PaintCanvas.tsx |
| **Flora** | paint | paintFlora(floraMap, cx, cz, kindIndex) → m.layers[layer][cell] = index | floraData.ts:114-125 |
| | erase | paintFlora(..., -1) or clearLayer | floraData.ts |
| **Zones** | paint | paintZoneCell(zoneMap, cx, cz, zoneIndex) → m.idx[...] = index | zoneData.ts:36-39 |
| | erase | paintZoneCell(..., -1) | zoneData.ts |
| **Roads** | click | Lay centerline point on click; profile set in RoadRail.tsx | painterBehavior.ts:31 |
| | erase | Delete road stroke under cursor | painterBehavior.ts:31, PaintCanvas.tsx ~1300 |
| **Objects** | paint (armed) | Place/stamp armed object (rotation + footprint snap) | placements.ts, PaintCanvas.tsx ~1250 |
| | erase | Delete placement under brush | painterBehavior.ts:33 |

**Brush Behavior Routing (painterBehavior.ts:18-37):**
- Tool × Target → Behavior: 'stroke' (continuous), 'click' (discrete), 'select', 'none'
- Example: tool=brush, target=height → 'stroke' behavior (up interpolates, move samples)
- Example: tool=brush, target=road → 'click' behavior (down lays point, up finishes)
- Example: tool=pointer, target=place → 'none' (native Canvas nodes, not overlay)

---

### 4. ROAD SYSTEM

**Road Grammar (roadData.ts entire file: 907 lines):**

- **Authored as STROKES:** polyline + cross-section profile (not tile-by-tile)
- **Profile:** { lanesF, lanesB (0 = one-way), sidewalks: bool, speedLimitKph?: number }
- **Constants (user-ruled):**
  - Lane width: 3 tiles (LANE_TILES, roadData.ts:76)
  - Sidewalk: 2 tiles each side (SIDEWALK_TILES, roadData.ts:78)
  - Median: 1 tile (two-way only)
  - Crosswalk depth: 2 tiles into each leg (CROSSWALK_DEPTH, roadData.ts:81)
  - Fillet radius: 5 tiles (ROAD_FILLET_TILES, roadData.ts:171)

**Compilation Pipeline:**

1. **filletPoints(points, radius)** (roadData.ts:173-199)
   - Interior vertices become quadratic-bezier arcs
   - Both tile raster AND analytic ribbon render the same curve → visual/gameplay agreement
   
2. **rasterizeCenterline(points)** (roadData.ts:203-223)
   - Filleted polyline → ordered, deduped centerline cells
   - 8-connected coverage via quarter-cell steps
   
3. **crossSection(profile)** (roadData.ts:234-262)
   - Carriage offsets (median + forward/backward lanes)
   - Sidewalk offsets (if enabled)
   
4. **rasterizeStroke(stroke)** (roadData.ts:285+) → StrokeRaster
   - Per-cell stamp with centerline order
   - Carriageway rank (closest to center wins at corners)
   - Travel-axis bits (AXIS_X/AXIS_Z) for junction crossing detection
   
5. **deriveJunctions(strokes)** (roadData.ts, called from intersections.ts)
   - Where carriageways CROSS → junction box (flow-neutral 'junction' tile)
   - 2-deep 'crosswalk' stamp outside each leg
   
6. **planRoads(strokes): RoadPlan** (roadData.ts:~600+)
   - Pure function: strokes → Map<cellKey, TileKind>
   - Every stroke composited into ONE tile result
   - testable independently (roadData.test.ts)
   
7. **Tile Stamping (editorWorld.ts → game mutators)**
   - Via game/world/grid.placeCell() — same API the game uses
   - Allows undo via roadUnder (cellKey → prior tile index)

**Intersections (intersections.ts: 220 lines, INTERSECTIONS-0619):**

| Component | Authored | Derived | Persistence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Junction box (where roads cross) | No (derived from strokes) | deriveJunctions() | Implicit in road recipe |
| Control type (4-way stop/signals/uncontrolled) | Yes | applied to junction | intersectionControls map |
| Generated props (stop sign / light / street sign) | No (derived) | planIntersectionProps() | Reconciled on load; manual pose overrides survive |
| Per-id pose overrides | Yes (user moved it) | Overlaid on fresh props | intersectionOverrides map |
| Street-name sign text | Derived from road names | resolveRoadNames() + junctionRoadNames() | Not persisted (re-derived) |

- Deterministic ID: gen:junctionKey:side:role → identity stable across re-derivations
- Ruling: "if i want to move things around u dont stop it" → pose overrides honored per ID

---

### 5. 2D → 3D WORLD BRIDGE

**Compile Path (editorWorld.ts + packageMap.ts):**

```
PaintCanvas chunk buffers
  (tiles: Int16Array, height: Float32Array, flora: FloraMap, water: Float32Array)
  
  ↓ chunkToFloor() [chunkFloor.ts:84-100]
  
ChunkFloor {
  cx, cz,
  tileData: encodeTileMap(tiles),
  heights: downsampleChunkFloorHeights(height.z),
  hcols, hrows,
  hver: version (bumps per height edit),
  water?: downsampled (stable ref unless edited),
  floraData?: encodeFloraMap(flora),
  roads?: roadRibbonSegments(strokes)
}
  
  ↓ floorsToLandforms() [chunkFloor.ts:176-198]
     + stable-identity cache (re-use Landform object if tileData/heights/hver unchanged)
  
Landform (game's heightfield shape):
  {
    id: "painted_cx_cz",
    kind: "heightfield",
    field: {
      cols, rows, cell (spacing),
      heights: number[] (downsampled from ChunkFloor),
      tiles: { cols, rows, idx: number[] },  ← decoded from tileData
      flora?: { cols, rows, layers }          ← decoded from floraData
      roads?: segments[]                      ← analytic ribbon for rendering + physics
    }
  }
  
  ↓ (parallel path) floorsToWaterBodies()
  
WaterBody (field-backed):
  {
    id: "painted_water_cx_cz",
    shape: "rect",
    field: { cols, rows, cell, heights (bed + depth), base, depths }
  }
```

**Key Transformations:**

| Stage | File | Input | Output | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Downsample | chunkFloor.ts:52-77 | 241×241 height samples (2/tile + 1) | 121×121 mesh vertices | Preview mesh resolution |
| Water surface | chunkFloor.ts:206-250 | Water depth grid | Per-cell surface (bed + depth) | Water visualization + physics |
| Water shore culling | chunkFloor.ts:217-230 | Depth + neighbor analysis | Keep deep, shallow only near deep | Clean beach contours |
| Flora decode | chunkFloor.ts:129-143 | floraData encoded array | { grass, tree, bush } layers | Population builder input |
| Road ribbon | chunkFloor.ts:85, roadData.ts | Strokes + chunk coords | 8-float segments per stroke | Shader analytic road + physics lane sticks |

**Rendering & Physics (game side, NOT editor):**

- Height mesh: displaced Landform mesh via heightfield collider (__game_physics_register_heightfield)
- Tile colors: per-cell tileData index → palette color (shader lookup)
- Flora: population builders (grassPopulation, palmPopulation) consume field.flora, scatter instances
- Roads: shader draws analytic ribbon (from road segments); lane sticks enforce AI navigation
- Water: field-backed surface mesh (per-cell bed + depth)

---

### 6. ZING HOST FUNCTIONS USAGE

**Paint system does NOT call Zig for data mutations — pure TypeScript:**

- **Height stamp:** stampBrush (TypeScript) mutates chunk.height.z in-place
- **Tile paint:** paintTile (TypeScript) mutates chunk.tiles.idx in-place
- **Flora paint:** paintFlora (TypeScript) mutates chunk.flora.layers in-place
- **Zone paint:** paintZoneCell (TypeScript) mutates chunk.zones.idx in-place
- **Water paint:** stampBrush on chunk.water (TypeScript)
- **Road compile:** planRoads (TypeScript pure function)

**Only Zig call in PaintCanvas:**

```typescript
__canvas_screen_to_graph(sx, sy, centerX, centerY)
→ returns { gx, gy } (screen to world coordinates, canvas affine transform)
```

**Physics registration (post-compile, LoaderIsoView.tsx):**

```typescript
__compiled_world_set_live_pieces(nodeId, rows)  // Push painted pieces to running game
__game_physics_register_heightfield(...)         // Register landform collider
__game_physics_clear_heightfields()              // Unload old
```

These are NOT in the hot paint path; they fire at stroke-end sync or compile time.

### 8. ARCHITECTURE HIGHLIGHTS

**Design Patterns:**

1. **Large buffers, O(1) mutations:** Chunks own Float32Array/Int16Array; brush stamps directly. No per-cell React nodes.

2. **Dirty tracking:** Per-chunk tileDirty/heightDirty/waterDirty. On sync, only dirty chunks re-encode.

3. **Stable identity caching:** landformCache reuses Landform objects if tileData/heights array refs unchanged → preview doesn't re-bake untouched chunks.

4. **Input-to-frame coalescing:** usePaintedField batches 100/s input events to once-per-frame GPU upload.

5. **Pure data pipeline:** planRoads, deriveJunctions, placeCell are all pure functions, testable independently.

6. **Per-target brush behavior routing:** One brush, many behaviors; painterBehavior resolves tool × target → behavior.

7. **Global sample frame for height:** Strokes straddle chunk borders; shared sample edge between chunks ensures no seam.

8. **Recipe not result storage:** Roads saved as strokes (recipe), not derived tiles; load-time re-derives via planRoads, preserving base terrain.

9. **Compound undo:** Strokes + placed objects + zones + tile overrides all ride the cart's undo system via editLog + per-stroke snapshots.

10. **Persist → Compile → Game:** Map snapshot → GameState (via mapStore → editorWorld mutators) → live game via saveGameState to hmsc boot key.

---

**Key Files for Migration to Zig:**

| Category | Files | Why Zig? | Complexity |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Stamp algorithms** | heightData.ts (stampBrush, stampRamp, stampSlopeSegment, stampSmooth) | Heavy per-cell math, many iterations | Medium—profile fitting, smoothstep blend |
| **Rasterization** | roadData.ts (rasterizeCenterline, rasterizeStroke, filletPoints, crossSection) | Polyline → cell grid, curve fitting | Medium—bezier math, dedup, rank tiebreak |
| **Encoding** | heightData.ts, tileData.ts, floraData.ts, zoneData.ts | Array iteration + palette encoding | Low—straightforward loops |
| **Grid queries** | chunks.ts, chunkFloor.ts | Neighbor lookups, bbox tests | Low—grid math, no algorithm complexity |

---

This completes the architectural map of the 2D tile painter. The system is built for scale: large typed buffers, O(1) cell mutations, frame-coalesced GPU uploads, and pure data transformations that can migrate to Zig independently.</result>
